billing_group_id.description: The ID of the billing group associated with the outbound proflile. Defaults to null (for no group assigned).

calling_window.description: (BETA) Specifies the time window and call limits for calls made using this outbound voice profile. Note that all times are UTC in 24-hour clock time.

calls_per_cld.description: (BETA) The maximum number of calls that can be initiated to a single called party (CLD) within the calling window. A null value means no limit.

end_time.description: (BETA) The UTC time of day (in HH:MM format, 24-hour clock) when calls are no longer allowed to start.

start_time.description: (BETA) The UTC time of day (in HH:MM format, 24-hour clock) when calls are allowed to start.

concurrent_call_limit.description: Must be no more than your global concurrent call limit. Null means no limit.

daily_spend_limit.description: The maximum amount of usage charges, in USD, you want Telnyx to allow on this outbound voice profile in a day before disallowing new calls.

daily_spend_limit_enabled.description: Specifies whether to enforce the daily_spend_limit on this outbound voice profile.

enabled.description: Specifies whether the outbound voice profile can be used. Disabled profiles will result in outbound calls being blocked for the associated Connections.

max_destination_rate.description: Maximum rate (price per minute) for a Destination to be allowed when making outbound calls.

name.description: A user-supplied name to help with organization.

whitelisted_destinations.description: The list of destinations you want to be able to call using this outbound voice profile formatted in alpha2.

call_recording_caller_phone_numbers.description: When call_recording_type is 'by_caller_phone_number', only outbound calls using one of these numbers will be recorded. Numbers must be specified in E164 format.

call_recording_channels.description: When using 'dual' channels, the final audio file will be a stereo recording with the first leg on channel A, and the rest on channel B.

call_recording_format.description: The audio file format for calls being recorded.

ServicePlan.description: Indicates the coverage of the termination regions.

TrafficType.description: Specifies the type of traffic allowed in this profile.

UsagePaymentMethod.description: Setting for how costs for outbound profile are calculated.
